gaps.sentence: The ___ (DECIDE) to close the factory was announced yesterday.
There were three ___ (BURGLE) on our street last month.
gaps.explanation: 'Three burglaries' — plural noun for the crime; burglars are people.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (INTRODUCE) of the euro changed European trade.
gaps.explanation: 'The introduction of' — the noun for starting something new.

gaps.sentence: It is ___ (DENY) that the policy has failed.
gaps.explanation: 'It is undeniable that …' — adjective meaning cannot be denied.

gaps.sentence: The road was closed because of ___ (VISIBLE) conditions.
gaps.hint: noun phrase: how far you can see
gaps.explanation: 'Visibility' = the distance you can see; paired with 'poor'.
